response.memory: Told Umi (masked, dorm neighbor) about Sidney's fever and cough; Umi said Skyler is waiting on a flu test at Vaden. Illness is spreading in the dorm, so I'll keep my distance and stay watchful.

messages.text: Heads up: Sidney in my dorm has a fever and cough, and Skyler is reportedly waiting on a flu test. I feel fine but I'm keeping my distance. Tell me if you feel off.
